DERYK / AREAS OF WORK

Four fields.
One long-term question.

Physical AI, Platform AI, Neural AI, and Gaming AI address distinct environments and problems. AGI remains a long-term research direction, not a product or an achieved capability.

01 / DEPARTMENT

Physical AI

Understanding changing physical or simulated environments.

02 / DEPARTMENT

Platform AI

Making capabilities reachable, reusable, and operable.

03 / DEPARTMENT

Neural AI

Researching what measured signals reveal through specialised models.

04 / DEPARTMENT

Gaming AI

Applying intelligence to interactive virtual worlds.

05 / DIRECTION
LONG-TERM RESEARCH DIRECTION

AGI

An open question: whether increasingly general intelligence can emerge from systems that model the world, remember, reason, act, and learn.

NOT A PRODUCT / NOT ACHIEVED
OUR THESIS

AI has learned
to generate.
The next step is
to understand and act.

The world is dynamic, complex, and physical. True intelligence requires more than language. It requires an understanding of the world, the ability to predict what happens next, and the capability to choose and execute actions safely.
